messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert triggered — GEN-QUEUE-P50 (us-west-1). Elevated 5xxs on streaming generation endpoints. Pager routed to @jordan.
jordan: acked. I'm on it. pulling logs and checking recent deploys.
samira: seeing a spike in KV cache misses around t-2m, correlates with GC churn on host-gpu-3. autoscaler is not failing but tail latency up ~300ms.
jordan: thanks. can you collect a short customer-impact blurb? maya should prepare a status update draft for publish.
maya: on it. first pass for initial status page copy below — please react with :thumbsup: to approve or suggest edits.
maya: ```We are investigating elevated error rates for streaming generation in us-west-1. Some requests are returning 5xx errors or experiencing increased latency. Our engineers are actively investigating and mitigation is in progress. We will provide updates every 30 minutes.``` 
alex: support queue seeing ~120 tickets in last 10m, mostly timeouts and partial responses. Customers affected: a subset of hosted API users in US-W region. Suggest we add customer guidance (retry/backoff) to the update.
maya: updated draft with guidance: ```If you see errors or partial responses, please retry with exponential backoff. If you continue to experience issues, contact support@getredwood.ai with request id and timestamps.``` 
legal: quick note — avoid phrasing that implies data loss. change "partial responses" -> "interrupted responses" and remove any speculation about root cause.
maya: updated wording per legal: ```We are investigating elevated error rates for streaming generation in us-west-1. Some requests may return 5xx errors or experience increased latency or interrupted responses. Engineers are actively investigating and mitigation is in progress. Please retry with exponential backoff; if issues persist contact support@getredwood.ai with request ID and timestamps. Updates every 30 minutes.``` 
jordan: infra mitigation in progress: restarting inference worker pool on host-gpu-3 and toggling aggressive GC flag on the runtime. Rolling deploy to unaffected hosts to offload traffic.
samira: confirming restart done on host-gpu-3, KV miss rate dropping from 45% -> 12% on that host. tail latency improving. continuing to monitor.
incident-bot: Next update window (30m) scheduled at +30 minutes from incident start.
alex: can we add a short note for customers using Dedicated/Private? some are asking. maybe: "This affects hosted api in us-west-1 only; Dedicated and Private deployments are not impacted unless routed through hosted control plane." legal ok?
legal: that's fine as long as it's accurate. i'd avoid naming specific customer types; use the suggested phrasing.
maya: final 30m update draft below. please sign off or tag edits.
maya: ```Update (30 min): We have mitigations underway and observed improvements after restarting affected workers. Error rates and tail latency are decreasing for affected hosts. If you continue to see interrupted responses, retry with exponential backoff and contact support@getredwood.ai with request ID and timestamps. This incident affects hosted API traffic in the us-west-1 region only. Engineers are monitoring and will provide another update in 30 minutes.``` 
jordan: :thumbsup: from oncall. samira — continue watch and if we see regression escalate to full pool restart.
samira: will do. setting a metric alert threshold to page at 10% 5xx across the cluster.
incident-bot: (auto) scheduled follow-up update posted at 30m.
maya: prepping resolved text when we have green. draft below for resolve notice:
maya: ```Resolved: The elevated error rates and interrupted responses in us-west-1 have been resolved. Root cause: a runtime GC regression that increased KV cache misses on a subset of worker hosts; mitigation included restarting affected workers and applying a runtime GC configuration change. No customer data was lost. If you continue to see issues, please contact support@getredwood.ai.``` 
legal: change: remove explicit root cause in public resolved — replace with "a runtime issue". keep "No customer data was lost." 
maya: updated resolved draft per legal:
maya: ```Resolved: The elevated error rates and interrupted responses in us-west-1 have been resolved. Engineers identified a runtime issue impacting a subset of worker hosts and applied mitigations (worker restarts and configuration updates). No customer data was lost. If you continue to see issues, please contact support@getredwood.ai.``` 
alex: support team ready to triage reopened tickets. can we add a short internal note for support with suggested triage steps? (post in #support separately)
jordan: yes — maya, can you export the request ids and a short triage checklist to #support? 
maya: will post checklist + CSV of request ids to #support after publish. also will publish initial update now (internal ops & public) w/ legal signoff.
jordan: publishing now. oncall continuing monitoring. ping here if anything changes.
incident-bot: Update posted to status page and ops channels. Thread resolved by oncall but remains open for monitoring.
samira: monitoring looks stable for last 8 minutes. no regressions.
alex: closing customer-facing follow-ups once support queue at baseline. thanks team.
maya: thanks everyone. will post resolved notice once we hold green for 15 minutes. :white_check_mark:
